Return the second-largest distinct integer in values, or None when fewer than two distinct values exist.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

  "args": [
    [
      8,

      6
    ]
  ],
  "expected": 6
}

  "args": [
    [
      5,
      5
    ]
  ],
  "expected": null
}
